raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / TRIFAMILIARE | NUOVA COSTRUZIONE A JESOLO NEW DEVELOPMENT · THREE-FAMILY HOUSE Trifamiliare | Nuova costruzione a Jesolo JESOLO PAESE · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €420,000 Photos (16) Floor plans (0) 1 / 16 FLOOR AREA 130 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo: the perfect balance between Sea, Comfort, and Nature. Located in one of the most strategic and rapidly expanding residential areas of the city, this stunning complex consisting of three portions of villas under construction offers the best of both worlds. The homes are positioned exactly between the tranquility and human-scale services of Jesolo Paese and the energy, beaches, and entertainment of Jesolo Lido, both reachable within just five minutes by car or via the convenience of a bike path. This is the ideal solution for those seeking maximum privacy without sacrificing proximity to the sea or convenient road connections, all complemented by a beautiful direct view over a wonderful public park. Emphasizing modern architecture and sustainability, this project aims to enhance the territory through a new concept of living where comfort, privacy, and quality construction coexist harmoniously. Each residence features its own private garden—a reserved space to enjoy year-round—perfect for relaxation, family time, and outdoor gatherings. The design solutions adopted ensure maximum independence among residences while creating an exclusive context that is elegant and fully immersed in greenery. The central unit develops harmoniously across two levels. On the ground floor welcomes guests with a spacious bright living area featuring an open kitchen exceeding 40 square meters designed to enhance daily life in a contemporary environment; completing this level are a functional bathroom,a practical hallway,and technical room. Ascending to the upper floor leads you into the sleeping area which includes two bedrooms,two dedicated terraces,a second bathroom,and ample attic space providing versatile spaces with appropriate privacy for every family member. Outside,the porchand private garden ideally extend indoor spaces creatingthe perfect environmentto relax outdoors throughout every season enrichedbythe convenienceofprivate parking.
